clpr.name: clpr
clpr.description: A place to find, organize, and share Twitch clips.
clpr.longDescription: clpr helps people discover Twitch clips, save them into organized collections, and share favorites with other viewers.
clpr.whyItExists: Twitch makes individual clips easy to create but hard to browse and organize later. clpr puts curation first.

patchwork.name: Patchwork
patchwork.description: Mutual aid search and coordination built on AT Protocol.
patchwork.longDescription: Patchwork is an AT Protocol mutual aid platform. It includes a web client, query API, ingestion and indexing pipeline, and moderation worker.
patchwork.whyItExists: Patchwork makes mutual aid requests searchable and moderatable while keeping the network on an open protocol.

hasanara.name: HasanAra
hasanara.description: Search the archive, save passages, and share moments with their source context.
hasanara.longDescription: HasanAra is a searchable video and transcript archive built on Rekolekt. Find a passage, return to its timestamp in the original recording, and save or share it with its source context.
hasanara.whyItExists: Video archives are difficult to search or cite. hasanara turns their speech into text that people can find, link, quote, and export.

transcript-create.name: Rekolekt
transcript-create.description: Searchable recordings. Quotable moments. Source intact.
transcript-create.longDescription: Rekolekt is the shared transcript archive application behind HasanAra. Turn long-form recordings into timestamped, searchable text, browse the archive, and save or share passages with their source context. Each archive can use its own identity and branding while running the same application core.
transcript-create.whyItExists: Recorded conversations need searchable text and links back to their sources. The shared application lets different archives use those tools with their own identity.

subcult-os.name: Subcult OS
subcult-os.description: Event planning, ticket scanning, and door tools for live scenes.
subcult-os.longDescription: subcult-os includes a web workspace for events, door operations, and run-of-show planning. Its React Native app gives hosts ticket scanning, invite management, and public event pages.
subcult-os.whyItExists: Small live events need practical tools for the door, guest list, schedule, and tickets without piecing together unrelated apps.

undertow.name: Undertow
undertow.description: A layered music visualizer and video editor with local MP4 exports.
undertow.longDescription: Undertow combines audio-reactive visualizers, artwork, text, timed lyrics, and video backgrounds in a layered editor. Create landscape, portrait, and square layouts, then export MP4 videos locally in the browser. Optional accounts and cloud rendering support saved projects and server exports.
undertow.whyItExists: Independent musicians need a way to turn a track into a visual release. Undertow brings the audio, artwork, lyrics, and export into one editor.
